title: Selector as ordered-list lookup
statement: For natural numbers $n,k,T$, six clause-family generators, and every natural-number index $i$, the selector that chooses among the $n$ pinning groups, the initial group, the $T$ state groups, the $T+1$ input groups, the $k(T+1)$ work groups ordered by time and then tape, and the $T$ acceptance groups equals lookup at index $i$ in that ordered list, with the empty formula as the out-of-range default.
hypotheses_covered: Generators for pinning, state, input, work, and acceptance groups, and an initial group
replaced: For all parameters and family generators and every ordinal $i$, the six-family selector at $i$ equals the lookup of the frozen ordered group list at $i$ with the empty default, including every family boundary.
